name: k8s control-plane dead-man — no readiness probe rows for 20 min
description: Fires when ZERO livespec.ci_k3s.readiness_check datapoints arrive in the trailing 20 min (evaluated every 10 min). The probe runs every minute, so silence means the timer, the unit or the collector is down; an absent probe is not a failed probe, so k8s API server readiness failing cannot fire on it. UNGROUPED, because a grouped query cannot fire on a silent subject. Emitter: ci-runner/observability/ci-k3s-control-plane-telemetry.sh (1-min timer, livespec-dev-tooling-vdleg7). Receiver: the poweredge-xubuntu otel-collector (thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml) -> Honeycomb env livespec. Runbook: ssh poweredge-xubuntu; systemctl status ci-k3s-control-plane-telemetry.timer ci-k3s-control-plane-telemetry.service; journalctl -u ci-k3s-control-plane-telemetry --since -30min. Plan kubernetes-node-observability (livespec-dev-tooling-dfdiil), item livespec-dev-tooling-t6om4l.
